card.name: Passive auxiliary after a subject noun
card.fires_on: The helper verbs 'be', 'was' or 'are' right after a subject, where a passive verb follows (should be given, was established). Also the 'intr' piece inside 'intramuscular' after 'deep'.

modes.label: Passive helper in dosing text
modes.description: 'be' or 'are' after 'should', 'may' or 'injections' in injection instructions, before a passive verb like given or made.
modes.example: Injections should<< be>> given subcutaneously in the outer aspect

modes.label: Passive 'was' in place history
modes.description: 'was' after a town, railway or post office subject in old local-history writing.
modes.example: A post office<< was>> established on the site of the village in

modes.label: Start of intramuscular
modes.description: The 'intr' piece of 'intramuscular' after 'deep' in injection directions.
modes.example: give by deep<< intr>>amuscular (IM) injection. Control

card.writes: It suppresses history-related words, so it steers the next word away from 'history' and 'historical' and toward a plain passive verb.
card.plain: It marks the little verb 'be' or 'was' that comes before a passive action word like 'given' or 'established'.
